old: Now that online classes are widely available, many students no longer need to travel far for good teachers.
new: Now that online translators can translate a whole article in seconds, some people fear that students will stop learning foreign languages.
理由: 原例句没有 some people fear that 引出担忧，与本句式的公式和“表达”对不上

old: 既然网课随处可得，许多学生不再需要跑很远去找好老师。
new: 既然网络翻译工具几秒钟就能译完一整篇文章，一些人担心学生会不再学外语。
理由: 随英文例句同步修改

old: Now that + 主语 + can + 动词1, 动词2 and 动词3, some people fear that + 完整句子
new: Now that + 主语 + can + 动词短语（可并列几个）…, some people fear that + 完整句子
理由: 公式要求三个并列动词，而两个例句都只有一个动词短语，公式与例句对不上

old: set an example in spreading positive information
new: set an example by spreading positive messages
理由: positive information 是“正能量信息”的直译，不地道；set an example by doing 更自然

old: No matter whether …, …
new: Regardless of whether …, …
理由: no matter whether 不是规范常用搭配，母语编辑会改成 regardless of whether / whether … or not

old: 不管是不是……，……
new: 不管是否……，……
理由: 随英文替换同步

old: 主语 + can easily + 动词原形 …
new: 主语 + 谓语（如 can easily + 动词原形）…
理由: 例句[1] many young people choose to … 没有 can easily，公式与例句对不上

old: keep / make + 宾语 + 形容词 …
new: 复数谓语（keep / make / help …）…
理由: 例句 make a good writer、help protect 都不是“keep / make + 宾语 + 形容词”，公式与例句对不上

old: 主语 + become + a little + 比较级 …
new: 主语 + become / make … + a little + 比较级 …
理由: 例句[0] we make the world a little warmer 用的是 make，不是 become

old: such as doing A or doing B
new: such as + 例子（动名词或名词）
理由: 例句[1] such as news reports or stories for teenagers 是名词，不是 doing

old: discover / find out + what
new: discover / find out / learn（或 teach sb）+ what
理由: 例句[1] A part-time job taught me what … 不是 discover / find out，公式与例句对不上

old: is valuable, because + 理由
new: is valuable / can be useful, because + 理由
理由: 例句[1] 用的是 can be useful，公式只写 is valuable

old: Whenever + 主语 + face + 名词
new: Whenever + 句子（遇到的情况）
理由: 例句 Whenever I come across …、Whenever there is a problem 都没有 face，公式与例句对不上

old: meet a new word
new: come across a new word
理由: “遇到生词”地道说法是 come across a new word，meet a new word 是中式英语

old: instead of 是介词短语
new: instead of 是复合介词（整体相当于一个介词）
理由: instead of 本身是复合介词，不是“介词 + 宾语”构成的介词短语

old: 主语 + 动词1, 动词2 and 动词3（好的做法）
new: 主语 + 谓语（好的做法，可以是一个或几个动词）
理由: 两个例句都只有一个动作（try to understand、should look for），与“三个动词”的公式对不上

old: 人 + who do so + will grow into
new: 人 + who + 做法（如 do so）+ will grow into
理由: 例句[0] Children who read every day 不是 who do so，公式与例句对不上

old: From A and B to C and D, 主语 + has become part of almost every aspect of + 名词
new: From A (and B) to C (and D), 主语 + has / have become part of + 名词
理由: 两个例句都是 From A to B，谓语 have become part of our daily routine / modern education，没有 every aspect of，公式与例句对不上

old: has penetrated every corner of our lives
new: has found its way into every corner of our lives
理由: penetrate every corner 是汉语“渗透到每个角落”的直译，母语者说 has found its way into every corner of our lives

old: especially in a global age
new: especially in today’s globalized world
理由: a global age 不是习惯说法，母语编辑会改成 today’s globalized world

old: 在全球化时代尤其如此
new: 在当今全球化的世界里尤其如此
理由: 随英文同步修改

old: Without + 名词, for instance, 人 + feel left behind because
new: Without + 名词,（for instance,）人 + feel left behind / lost because
理由: 例句[1] 没有 for instance，用的是 feel lost，公式与例句对不上

old: being trapped by stress
new: being weighed down by stress
理由: trapped by stress 不地道，“被压力压得喘不过气”英语说 weighed down by stress

old: 被压力困住
new: 被压力压得喘不过气
理由: 随英文同步修改

old: 主语 + is impossible without + 名词
new: 主语 + 谓语（真正要讲的道理）…
理由: 例句 a child cannot grow up healthy without love、the human body needs exercise 都不是 is impossible without，公式与例句对不上

old: 每一门生意
new: 每一家企业
理由: every business 指每家企业/商家，“每一门生意”搭配别扭

old: 人 + who has not … , for example, + will find it almost impossible to + 动词原形 …
new: 主语 + will / may find it + 形容词（almost impossible / hard / difficult）+ to + 动词原形 …
理由: 例句 find it hard、may find it difficult，且无 who has not / for example，公式与例句对不上；原公式逗号前还多一个空格

old: 人1 + who … can …, whereas those who … often …
new: 人1 + who … + 谓语 …, whereas those who … + 谓语 …
理由: 例句用 tend to sleep well、remember it longer / soon forget，并没有 can … often，公式与例句对不上

old: Unfortunately, some + 人
new: （Unfortunately,）some / many + 人
理由: 例句[1] Many students, worried about … 没有 Unfortunately、用 many，公式与例句对不上

old: as soon as they meet difficulties
new: as soon as they run into difficulties
理由: meet difficulties 是中式英语，母语者说 run into / encounter difficulties

old: With + 形容词 + 名词, 主语 + can + 动词 + much further …
new: With + 名词短语, 主语 + can + 动词原形 …
理由: 例句[0] can enjoy life to the full 没有 much further，例句[1] With the support of … 不是“形容词 + 名词”，公式与例句对不上

old: 主语 + tended to + 动词 …, from A to B, leaving
new: 主语 + tend(ed) to / used to + 动词 …,（from A to B,）leaving
理由: 例句用 tend to、used to，且都没有 from A to B，公式与例句对不上

old: teaching them what … and what …
new: teaching + 人 + what / how …
理由: 两个例句都是 teaching us / couples how to …，公式只写 what … and what …

old: how + 形容词 + I felt + when + 具体事情 + at the age of …
new: how + 形容词 + I felt / was + when + 具体事情（+ at the age of …）
理由: 例句[0] 没写年龄，例句[1] 用 how happy I was，公式与例句对不上

old: 第三段用 Of course 转折
new: 第三段用 Of course 让步
理由: 本篇其他各处（句式[5]、步骤[5]、要求[4]）都把 Of course 讲成让步，这里说“转折”前后不一

old: should + 动词1, 动词2 and 动词3 …
new: should + 动词 …（可并列几个动词）
理由: 例句[0] 只有一个动词，例句[1] 两个，公式写死三个，对不上

old: When + 名词 + is / are valued, everyone benefits.
new: When + 名词 + is / are + 过去分词, everyone / 人 + benefit(s).
理由: 例句 every voice is respected、the environment is protected … future generations benefit，不是 valued / everyone，公式与例句对不上

old: may + 动词原形 + when doing …
new: may + 动词原形 …（如 when doing …）
理由: 例句[0] may feel tired even after a short walk 没有 when doing，公式与例句对不上

old: shift from simply buying more things
new: shift from constantly buying more things
理由: simply 与后面的 simpler 撞词、读来别扭；且汉语“一味地”对应 constantly 更贴切

old: + 主语 + are based on + B + rather than + C
new: + 句子（多为 … be based on / be spent on + B）+ rather than + C
理由: 例句[0] our time is spent on important tasks … 不是 are based on，公式与例句对不上

old: 主语 + 动词1 … and 动词2 …
new: 主语 + 谓语（正确的做法，可并列两个动词）…
理由: 例句[0] she started a recycling program 只有一个动词，公式写死两个

old: not only + 动词过去式1 … but also + 动词过去式2 …
new: not only + 动词1 … but also + 动词2 …（两个动词时态一致）
理由: 例句[1] Regular exercise not only keeps … but also improves … 是一般现在时，公式写死“过去式”

old: Ultimately, the goal of + 名词
new: （Ultimately,）the goal / purpose of + 名词
理由: 例句[1] The purpose of sports … 没有 Ultimately、用 purpose，公式与例句对不上

old: 挑 2005 年、2012 年两个整数关口
new: 挑 2005 年、2012 年两个关键数据
理由: 21% 不是“整数关口”，说法不准确

old: towards
new: toward
理由: 全文统一美式拼写，美式用 toward

old: 名词 + 过去分词短语 to + 名词 + 形容词短语
new: 名词 + 后置修饰（过去分词短语 / 介词短语）to + 名词 + 后置修饰（形容词短语 / 过去分词短语）
理由: 公式与例句对不上：例句用 a dream for most families、a tool used by almost everyone，不全是“过去分词短语 … 形容词短语”

old: + doing … and making sure that + 完整句子
new: + doing …（and making sure that + 完整句子）
理由: 公式与例句对不上：例句[0]没有 making sure that，应标为可选

old: 主语 + will contribute even more to + 名词
new: 主语 + will + 动词原形 … even more（如 contribute even more to + 名词）
理由: 公式与例句对不上：例句[0]是 will become even more livable

old: Faced with + 名词1, 名词2 and 名词3, 主语 + 谓语 …
new: Faced with + 名词（可以几项并列）, 主语 + 谓语 …
理由: 公式与例句对不上：两个例句 Faced with 后都只有一个名词，学生会以为必须写三项

old: can hardly + 动词原形
new: can / could hardly + 动词原形
理由: 例句[1]是过去时 could hardly，公式只写 can

old: In fact, A and B are closely linked: 具体事实（主语 + may + 动词1 … and 动词2 …）
new: （In fact,）A and B are closely linked: 具体事实（一个完整的句子）
理由: 公式与例句对不上：两个例句冒号后都不是 may + 两个动词，例句[1]也没有 In fact

old: 名词B + is / are often + 形容词1 and 形容词2
new: 名词B + 谓语 …（写出 B 与 A 不同的特点）
理由: 公式与例句对不上：例句是 can be carried around、often brings results，不是 is often + 两个形容词

old: as carefully as
new: as + 副词（如 carefully / seriously）+ as
理由: 例句[1]用 as seriously as，讲解也说 as + 副词 + as，公式写死 carefully

old: After all, a truly + 形容词 + 名词 + requires both A and B.
new: （After all,）a (truly) + 形容词 + 名词 + requires / needs + both A and B.
理由: 公式与例句对不上：例句[0]没有 truly，例句[1]没有 After all、用的是 needs

old: can + transform / improve + 宾语
new: can + 动词原形 …（如 transform / improve + 宾语）
理由: 公式与例句对不上：例句是 can help us …、can become …

old: be flooded with + 名词1, 名词2 and 名词3 + from + 来源
new: be flooded with + 名词（可以几项并列）（+ from + 来源）
理由: 公式与例句对不上：例句[0]只有一个名词 tourists，例句[1]没有 from

old: 主语 + can + 做法1, 做法2 and 做法3 + before doing …
new: 主语 + can + 正确做法（可以几项并列）（+ before doing …）
理由: 公式与例句对不上：两个例句都没有三项做法，也没有 before doing

old: 主语, from A to B, + be + too
new: 主语（, from A to B,）+ be + too
理由: 例句[0]没有 from A to B 插入语，应标为可选

old: When doing …, 主语 + learn to
new: When doing … / By doing …, 主语 + learn to
理由: 例句[0]以 By doing 开头，与公式不符

old: Such + 名词, once considered + 形容词, have become part of + 名词
new: （Such +）名词, once considered + 形容词 / 名词短语, has / have become + 名词短语（如 part of …）
理由: 公式与例句对不上：例句[0]无 Such、单数 has；例句[1] once considered a waste of time、have become a popular way

old: If we all play our part, + 主语 + will be + 比较级 + 名词 + for + 对象
new: If we all play our part / If everyone plays their part, + 主语 + will be / become + 比较级 …
理由: 公式与例句对不上：例句[0]没有 for + 对象，例句[1]是 If everyone plays their part … will become cleaner

old: doing sth + is essential for
new: doing sth / 名词 + is essential for
理由: 例句[1]主语是名词 Regular exercise，不是动名词

old: than any single + 名词
new: than any single + 名词 / than ever
理由: 例句[0]是 more important than ever，与公式不符

old: feeling of success
new: a feeling of success
理由: 可数用法缺冠词，学生照写会出错（对应 a sense of achievement）

old: many of them + cannot / fail to …
new: many / few of them + 谓语 …
理由: 例句[0]是 few of them read regularly，例句[1]是 feel lonely，与 cannot / fail to 不符

old: , and + 另一个原因
new: （, and + 另一个原因）
理由: 两个例句都没有 and + 另一个原因，应标为可选

old: teaching / helping + 人 + how to + 做法1, 做法2 and 做法3
new: teaching / helping + 人 +（how to +）具体做法（可以几项并列）
理由: 公式与例句对不上：例句[0]两项做法，例句[1] helping old people recognize 没有 how to

old: 主语 + should develop the habit of + thinking twice before + doing …
new: 主语 + should develop the habit of thinking twice / should think twice + before + doing …
理由: 例句[1] Young people should think twice before … 没有 develop the habit of

old: Some students spend so much time on their phones that they cannot sleep well.
new: Some students spend so much time on their phones that they cannot sleep well. Others stay up late playing games.
理由: 句式是 Some … Others … 分述句，例句[0]只有 Some 一半，示范不了句式

old: 有些学生花太多时间玩手机，以至于睡不好觉。
new: 有些学生花太多时间玩手机，以至于睡不好觉；另一些学生则熬夜打游戏。
理由: 随英文例句补上 Others 一句

old: , such as + doing …
new: （, such as + doing …）
理由: 两个例句都没有 such as 部分，应标为可选

old: Although + 主语 + comes from … / is well-meant, it often does more harm than good.
new: Although + 主语 + comes from … / is well-meant / 有某种好处, it / they often do(es) more harm than good.
理由: 例句[1]是 may raise test scores、复数 they … do，与公式不符

old: to children’s health
理由: 补习对健康谈不上“利”，do more harm than good to children’s health 逻辑不通；让步说的是分数，判断应针对整体

old: 却往往对孩子的健康弊大于利
new: 却往往弊大于利
理由: 随英文修改；“对健康弊大于利”逻辑不通

old: may lack + 名词 and + 名词
new: may lack + 名词（可以两项并列）
理由: 两个例句 lack 后都只有一项（practical skills、the courage to face failure）

old: should first + 动词原形 … and realize that + 完整句子
new: should first + 动词原形 …（如 realize that + 完整句子）
理由: 例句[0]没有 realize that，例句[1]只有 realize that，都不符合“动词 + and realize that”

old: by + doing … and + doing …
new: by + doing …（可以两项并列）
理由: 例句[1] by praising … 只有一项
